# Khuddakavatthuvibhaṅga (Vb 17)
**ID:** Vb 17
**Section:** Vibhaṅga (vb)
**Collection:** Abhidhamma
**Title (Pali):** Khuddakavatthuvibhaṅga
**Title (English, from literature):** Analysis of Minor Matters
**SuttaCentral:** https://suttacentral.net/vb17
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/abh02m.mul16.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
Following a *mātikā* (matrix), the exposition classifies these unwholesome dhammas numerically into groups of single items, pairs, triads, and up through sets of ten, supplemented by groupings of eighteen and 108 forms of craving [Nyanatiloka 2007; Ñāṇamoli 2010].
